notifications.focusMessage: Recover your energy: hydrate and take a short break
notifications.breakMessage: Back to focus when you're ready.
focusToBreakTips: Remember the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look 20 meters away for 20 seconds.
This break is part of your progress: do not fill it with more screen time.
Drink some water: staying hydrated also helps sustain concentration.
Relax your shoulders and straighten your back: small adjustments prevent tension build-up.
breakToFocusTips: Today counts too, even if it is small.
Being here is already part of progress.
What matters is not breaking the rhythm.
Showing up today is what makes the difference.
